name: Approval without vote
title: RECOMMENDATION FOR SECOND READING on the Council position at first reading with a view to the adoption of a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on European Union labour market statistics on businesses, repealing Council Regulation (EC) No 530/1999 and Regulations (EC) No 450/2003 and (EC) No 453/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament has approved the Council's position on a new regulation on European Union labour market statistics on businesses. This replaces three older regulations from 1999, 2003 and 2008 with a single set of rules for collecting statistics about businesses and their workers. The report does not add any changes of its own; it simply confirms the deal already agreed between Parliament and the Council. The new rules aim to make these statistics more consistent across the European Union.

- **What changes:** Three old regulations on business labour statistics are replaced by one new regulation.
- **Who it affects:** Businesses that report labour market data, and the national bodies that collect it.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President and the Council's President sign the act, and it is published in the Official Journal.
